title: New hand, 10 active seats
acceptance: Exactly 20 unique hole cards, burn/deal according to rules, at most 5 board cards; all cards unique

title: Shuffle 100k generated decks (if feasible)
acceptance: No repeated card within deck; no fixed seat/Hero bias; report statistical test with uncertainty, not proof of perfect fairness

title: Tests with same deterministic seed and same actions
acceptance: Exact same dealer state/results in test mode

title: Production-mode two consecutive hands
acceptance: Independent, non-forced random shuffles; seeded fixtures inaccessible from ordinary UI

title: A-2-3-4-5 vs 2-3-4-5-6
acceptance: Six-high straight wins, wheel is five-high

title: Four cards of one suit on board plus qualifying own suit
acceptance: Correct flush, not any five cards of mixed suits

title: Same top pair but different kicker
acceptance: Correct kicker winner

title: Board makes best five-card hand for two players
acceptance: Correct tie/split/odd chip per configured rules

title: Two pair vs trips; flush vs straight; full house vs flush; quads vs full house; straight flush
acceptance: Correct ranking ordering and best-five selection

title: Hero folds preflop
acceptance: Hero cards remain hidden by default; future board not scripted for educational outcome

title: HU button/SB acts preflop
acceptance: Button = SB, acts first preflop; BB acts first postflop

title: 3–10 handed
acceptance: First preflop actor after BB/live straddle; first postflop actor left of button among active players

title: Several physical seats empty
acceptance: Determine button and blinds based on occupied seat sequence, not seat label

title: Big blind offered option after limpers/calls
acceptance: BB may check or raise; a preflop call from SB alone does not auto-end the round

title: Bet 100 → opponent raises to 260
acceptance: Prior full raise increment is 160; next minimum full raise-to 420, if stack allows

title: A bet 100 → B short all-in 150
acceptance: A's earlier action is not reopened solely by +50; if another full valid raise occurs, re-evaluate

title: A bet 100 → B all-in 140 → C all-in 180
acceptance: Cumulative +80 is short of a full 100; if A already acted, cannot re-raise under selected rule

title: A bet 100 → B all-in 150 → C all-in 200
acceptance: Cumulative reaches full +100; A's raise rights re-open as specified by selected rule profile

title: Hero owes 20 and has 13 remaining
acceptance: Exact 13 all-in call permitted; no negative stack; side-pot eligibility correct

title: Raise-to amount below minimum with enough stack
acceptance: UI disables/engine rejects; an under-min all-in is allowed if truly entire stack

title: Legal raise-to 16 at $1/$2
acceptance: UI shows raise to $16 rather than “raise by $16”; exact total street commitment = $16

title: Rapid double-click on Call/Jam
acceptance: Exactly one action recorded and one chip transfer

title: Hero not actor
acceptance: All action buttons locked; bot transitions cannot override Hero decision

title: End of street
acceptance: Each non-folded/non-all-in actor has matched the valid wager or acted as needed; reset street contributions and advance exactly once

title: Single eligible player after folds
acceptance: Award uncontested pot; do not need showdown or force reveal

title: Every active player all-in
acceptance: No requests for further player action; complete runout and settle

title: No-limit raise sequence
acceptance: No arbitrary limit on number of raises; finite stack prevents illegal infinite loop

title: Invalid inputs NaN, negatives, fractions below chip unit, huge amounts
acceptance: Reject safely; no chip/pot mutation

title: Switching 9-handed to heads-up after seat exits
acceptance: Correct button/blind and cash rule profile transitions; no missing blind

title: Four active players all-in for 50, 120, 300, 300
acceptance: Main pot 200 (A/B/C/D eligible); side pot1 210 (B/C/D eligible); side pot2 360 (C/D eligible), prior to rake/returns

title: One all-in player loses main, wins separate side?
acceptance: Enforce eligibility strictly; cannot win pot in which they did not contribute

title: Player folds after putting chips in
acceptance: Contributed chips remain as dead money, not returned

title: Uncalled excess raise
acceptance: Return unmatched portion before rake and final pot allocation

title: Two equal-ranked winners of odd-chip total
acceptance: Split as defined by rule profile; no creation/loss of a fractional smallest unit

title: Rake-free 10k mixed-stack hands
acceptance: Sum of live stacks after each hand = sum before hand, excluding external wallet moves

title: Rake-on 10k mixed-stack hands
acceptance: Sum(live stacks after) + cumulative rake/drop = sum(live stacks before), with proper adjustments for topups/cashouts

title: No-flop-no-drop, everyone folds preflop
acceptance: No standard flop-triggered rake assessed

title: Rake 5% capped $5 on postflop $200 pot
acceptance: $5 rake under standard simple rule; document any rounding/local exceptions

title: Change rake from no-rake to 5%-cap profile
acceptance: Old hands retain historical rake and stats; new hands use selected version

title: Wallet $1200 → buy in $300 → lose $40 → external wallet +$1000 → top up $40
acceptance: Wallet $1860, table $300, net poker result −$40, total virtual assets $2160 (before rake already included in loss)

title: Reset wallet only
acceptance: Poker hand history and hand profit unchanged; external adjustment logged

title: Reset session only
acceptance: Distinct from history deletion and bankroll reset

title: All-in player remains in main pot
acceptance: Their chips stay in main pot; cannot bet further; correct showdown

title: Choose each 2–10 maximum seat count
acceptance: Visual layout and action order valid

title: 10 seats, 6 occupied including Hero
acceptance: Empty seats distinguishable, no empty bot action

title: Heads-up button position on rotating deals
acceptance: Correct across at least 20 hands

title: 9-handed $1/$2 with $300 Hero stack
acceptance: 150BB initial stack; correct blinds and min raises

title: $1/$3 vs $2/$5 vs $50/$100
acceptance: All pot/stack/BB conversions exact

title: Custom SB $3, BB $7 and stacks $350
acceptance: Correct display, validation and legal min opening bet

title: Set five bot types, one Random, one Unknown
acceptance: Assigned known types display correctly, Unknown hides actual type; Random follows chosen semantics

title: Reconfigure seat between hands
acceptance: Next hand uses new seat/stack/profile; prior hand untouched

title: Attempt reconfigure while active hand
acceptance: Safely queued, disabled or requires explicit safe hand end; no silent mid-hand state rewrite

title: Clone named preset and modify rake
acceptance: Original preset preserved and new preset saved

title: Inspect `BotObservation`
acceptance: Only own hole cards + public board/actions/stacks/positions/eligible legal actions; NO Hero cards or future board

title: Replace Hero hole cards without changing public state in isolated test
acceptance: Bot decisions have the same conditional distribution, other than changes legitimately caused by card removal if that information is hidden and therefore should not be accessible

title: Hold bot own cards and public actions constant, reseed future board
acceptance: Bot action probability invariant to future card order

title: Bot code attempts `gameState.deck`
acceptance: Not exposed; API rejects or code isolation prevents access

title: Hero folded hidden hand
acceptance: Bot cannot retroactively read it, including in opponent memory

title: Unknown opponent identity
acceptance: True type not revealed to Hero or telemetry shown during hand; user can elect post-session insight

title: Bot policy proposes 3× stack or illegal check
acceptance: Engine rejects; safe fallback, logged violation; no malformed pot

title: Optional LLM generated player speech
acceptance: Speech receives public context and weak personality cues, not private hidden cards or definitive true opponent belief

title: TAG UTG vs TAG BTN unopened
acceptance: BTN opens materially more weighted combos than UTG, accounting for table format

title: Nit vs Calling Station: flop naked gutshot facing 25% pot
acceptance: Station calls more often than nit in ordinary comparable configs

title: Nit vs Station: same gutshot facing 175% pot
acceptance: Both call less often than vs 25% in baseline situation; nit especially unlikely

title: Fit-or-Fold vs LAG: unpaired no-draw air facing reasonable flop bet
acceptance: Fit-or-Fold folds more often; some position/backdoor exceptions allowed

title: Same bot: OESD vs naked gutshot, equal price/street
acceptance: OESD generally defends more with relevant equity/implied odds, context caveats

title: Same bot: flop vs river naked gutshot
acceptance: On river no future draw; cannot count as a draw or call “to hit”

title: Same bot: 1 opponent vs 4 opponents
acceptance: Typical weak-bluff/weak-overcall rates reduce in multiway environment, ceteris paribus

title: Calling Station vs Strong TAG: weak pair versus medium river bet
acceptance: Station often finds more calls, TAG evaluates range and can fold

title: Maniac vs Nit: opportunity for uncalled preflop open/3bet
acceptance: Maniac raises with much higher frequency, but still legal and private-card dependent

title: Strong reg vs weak recreational: river value hand on dangerous board
acceptance: Strong reg adjusts size/line more accurately on average; avoid unconditional "always best" claims

title: Tricky reg with strong set vs straightforward TAG
acceptance: Tricky reg slowplays at nonzero frequency; TAG may usually bet/raise more for value in suitable conditions

title: Calling Station with top pair vs no pair
acceptance: Must respond meaningfully to own holdings, not ignore cards

title: Unknown assigned type
acceptance: Statistics resemble assigned private type across hand sample, while on-screen label remains hidden

title: Two stations with same base archetype but distinct personal seeds
acceptance: Similar population behavior but different stable individual preferences; avoid clones

title: Small flop bet vs large bet across a smooth call-price curve
acceptance: Conditional defense responds to price without abrupt impossible discontinuities unless explicitly hard-capped

title: Turn flush card completes opponent's perceived draws
acceptance: Bet/check/call/raise weights respond to board change, not unchanged static sheet

title: Short vs deep SPR with draw
acceptance: Changed implied odds/jam options produce plausible action shifts

title: Opponent becomes aggressive for two observed hands
acceptance: Memory should not instantly assume reliable long-term type change; uncertainty shrinks as sample grows

title: Same cards but limped pot vs 3-bet pot
acceptance: Different ranges and SPR produce different action weights

title: Opponent policy vs itself and vs adversarial hero
acceptance: No trivially deterministic auto-profit loop caused by coding error

title: At $1/$2, Hero wins $40 over 100 dealt hands
acceptance: Observed simulated rate = +20 bb/100

title: At $2/$5, Hero loses $50 over 100 dealt hands
acceptance: Observed simulated rate = −10 bb/100

title: Combine G01 and G02
acceptance: Combined net BB = +10 across 200 hands, hence +5 bb/100; never divide −$10 net by currently selected blind size

title: +10 bb/100 projected at 30 hands/hour
acceptance: Model-projected +3 BB/hour; labeled projected not measured

title: Play 100 hands against cartoon station profiles
acceptance: Warning remains that this result is simulator-population-specific; no real-win claim

title: Virtual bankroll deposit or rebuy
acceptance: No change in sum of poker hand results

title: 3bet rate denominator
acceptance: 3bets divided by genuine 3bet opportunities, not all hands dealt

title: VPIP/PFR
acceptance: Preflop voluntarily put money in / raised, not forced blind/ante

title: Very small sample
acceptance: Display N and uncertain estimate; no “verified winning player” green badge

title: All-in adjusted EV unavailable
acceptance: UI says NOT IMPLEMENTED; no fabricated EV line

title: Change opponent model version
acceptance: Stats segmented/versioned; old results not silently treated as current population

title: Real poker records uploaded by user (future)
acceptance: Separate actual-live vs simulated; missing data flagged, never interpolated as certain

title: Keep a bot's private style identity across hands
acceptance: Same profile/seed stable; randomness changes lines not identity

title: Two individually sampled TAGs
acceptance: Distributionally same broad archetype; repeatable differences in sizes/lines across independent seed batches

title: Position and prior action jointly affect preflop entry
acceptance: Same 169-class holding conditional open/limp/cold-call/3bet decisions differ by actual node

title: Multiway vs heads-up calling
acceptance: Same holding, bet price, street; rate changes with callers/players left to act; do not use heads-up odds mechanically

title: Deep stack vs shallow stack
acceptance: Action mixes and sizing change coherently with SPR and implied/reverse-implied risk

title: Flop OESD vs naked gutshot
acceptance: Correct distinct features and adjustable price responses; no draw class on river

title: Dirty draw vs clean draw
acceptance: Discounted outs and dangerous runouts change response and are not secretly based on unknown cards

title: Monotone/pairing/completing turn
acceptance: Persist weighted opponent ranges from public prior lines; no resurrected impossible combos

title: Bet 25%, 50%, 100%, 200%, 300% pot
acceptance: Conditional call curves report actual percentages and opportunity count; monotone baseline where applicable and exceptions explained

title: Tiny raise, overbet, unusual sizes
acceptance: Policy interpolates or reacts to off-tree sizing without action failure or universal fixed fold

title: Button/UTG frequencies across cash and tournament
acceptance: Per-opportunity distribution conditioned on position and mode; no fixed VPIP random per hand

title: Calling station vs nit over long test
acceptance: Meaningful differences in draw calls, weak pair continuations and response to big raises; no scripted hero advantage

title: Hero replacement with another unrelated hand
acceptance: Bot with fixed observation and RNG gives same decision distribution; card-removal from hidden Hero cards is prohibited

title: Future deck permutation
acceptance: Fixed bot observations and RNG give equivalent action distribution; no future board peek

title: Public memory with 2 villain samples
acceptance: Extreme new classification not treated as certainty; uncertainty recorded and surfaced in diagnostics

title: Public memory with showdown and unrevealed folds
acceptance: Only revealed cards update exact combos; unrevealed folds remain probabilistic

title: Prior action sequences
acceptance: Flop-call→turn-bet and limp-call→river-call distributions checked, not just marginal VPIP/PFR

title: Actual human holdout where data legally available
acceptance: Player/session/venue-disjoint holdout predictive loss compared against simple baseline; record unavailable if no such data

title: Coverage by context
acceptance: Report number of independently observed human opportunities per street/size/board/stake; no blind R3/R4 certification

title: Independent strategic benchmarks
acceptance: Strong profile tested against distinct frozen strategies and validated references without using its own policy as gold standard

title: Exploit probes
acceptance: Always minbet, hyper-overbet, limp-all, never bluff, always call, max aggression; report vulnerability cause, not auto-mark all exploitability as unrealistic

title: Uncalibrated high-stakes presets
acceptance: Never describe as empirical $50/$100 behaviors; source and priors visible, different stake/rake effective size only if evidenced

title: 9-handed table ecology
acceptance: Multiway, limps, ISO, folds and stack trends from interactions among ALL bots; bots cannot ignore bot-on-bot actions

title: Timing-tell probe
acceptance: Card strength cannot be perfectly decoded from think-time; include no-tell setting and bounded noisy cue policy

title: 9-handed single-table freezeout
acceptance: User/automated actor can reach a unique winner through real complete NLHE hands

title: Blind level schedule
acceptance: New SB/BB/ante applies at documented hand boundary; no retroactive alteration of in-progress hand

title: BB ante with short big blind
acceptance: Exactly specified ante/blind funding priority and pot eligibility per chosen tournament rule version

title: Tournament heads-up transition
acceptance: Dealer/SB and BB correct when ring collapses to two players

title: Elimination standings
acceptance: Correct rank/order for separate and simultaneous bustouts; tie-break configured

title: Virtual entry accounting
acceptance: Entry fee separated from prize pool; tournament chips not confused with cash wallet

title: Payout ladder with bubble
acceptance: Prize payouts exactly match ladder and prize liabilities; no rounding double pay

title: Tournament completion
acceptance: Final prize awarded once; frozen tournament cannot be resumed for extra payouts

title: Re-entry eligibility
acceptance: Only post-elimination, within window and remaining entry cap; new event-entry record and fresh stack

title: Rebuy eligibility
acceptance: Only within configured stage/stack limits; not incorrectly treated as a re-entry

title: Add-on eligibility
acceptance: Only defined break/window; single charge/stack grant idempotent

title: Late registration
acceptance: Only before deadline/field stop; new player legal seating and full starting stack as configured

title: Background MTT tables
acceptance: All tables advance real legal hands with separate decks and chip-conserving local pots

title: MTT balancing
acceptance: Reasonable occupancy parity; correct moving-player blind obligations and no duplicate participants

title: Final-table creation
acceptance: No chip loss, player duplication, incorrect button or missing seat; proper payout stage

title: Hand-for-hand synchronization
acceptance: Bubble payouts cannot be altered by some tables jumping several extra hands ahead

title: Turbo/hyper structures
acceptance: Scheduler transitions at configured intervals, with correct pause/resume behavior

title: Event interruption
acceptance: Serializing mid-hand/paused tournament and reopening preserves active players, prize pool, exact clocks and action queue

title: KO elimination
acceptance: Bounty awarded to correct player(s), shared-elimination case follows chosen ruleset, prize pool reconciles

title: PKO update
acceptance: Cash portion credited once; progressive portion increases collector's bounty; total bounty liabilities conserved

title: Tournament opponent adaptation
acceptance: Short-stack and bubble pressure affect decisions conditional on unchanged own cards/public situation; label approximations

title: Tournament results display
acceptance: Finish, ITM, cumulative entry+fees, payout, ROI; does not contaminate cash bb/100

title: True full-field scoreboard
acceptance: Field counts are based on simulated eliminations rather than invented background timer collapses

title: Tournament rules provenance
acceptance: Actual rules version and event profile stored for each event and accessible on replay

title: One-click live $1/$2 preset
acceptance: Opens 9-handed $300 table and is fully editable; preset called synthetic, not measured venue fact

title: Full mobile 10-seat portrait and landscape
acceptance: No invisible players, overlapping controls, clipped cards or mistaken seat buttons

title: Custom bet-amount entry
acceptance: Bet, raise-to vs raise-by, pot fractions and legal min/max are correct even facing bet or short stack

title: Quick bet presets
acceptance: 25/33/50/75/100/150/200% pot calculate using documented pot basis; user can edit BB/increment shortcuts

title: Pause and autoresume
acceptance: Never changes waiting Hero decision or advances street while waiting for input

title: Next-hand/autodeal
acceptance: Hero can stop at end of hand; no rapid unintended launch after showdown

title: User-selectable card showdown
acceptance: Reveal only rules-permitted cards; no folded unseen card leak in public player mode

title: Hand history download
acceptance: Complete stakes, rule version, player order, contributions, boards, showdowns and policy versions; replays match exactly

title: Preset custom save/load
acceptance: Saved seat profiles/stack/rake restored exactly without altering unrelated session histories

title: Keyboard and screen reader
acceptance: Core actions operable and properly announced without animation-only meaning

title: Real device performance
acceptance: Measure decision compute P50/P95, 10-seat frame responsiveness and input-to-confirm latency on specified phone/desktop

title: Long-session resource performance
acceptance: 10,000 simulated hands/sessions under test harness; memory baseline and trend, bounded storage, no runaway timers

title: Instant multiple touch
acceptance: One and only one betting action per idempotency ID across network retry/race

title: Different browser reload and interrupted save
acceptance: Transactional snapshot/event log resumes or safely rolls back incomplete action; never duplicates payout

title: Unknown profile editor separation
acceptance: Reveal/debug hidden type only after session or explicit separate lab mode; active gameplay concealment persists

title: App launch from new Site
acceptance: Verified unique project ID + site URL, deployment build, original sites unchanged by all write calls

title: Cash bankroll external edit
acceptance: Wallet adjusts with external ledger entry; hand results and bb/100 unchanged

title: Cash top-up and payout
acceptance: Wallet+table+house drop conserved across buyin, hand, cashout and external adjustment

title: Side pots with folded contribution
acceptance: Folded money stays in correctly sized tier; only live eligible players can win each pot

title: Multiway all-in + rake edge
acceptance: Exact odd chips, refunds and caps under chosen rules; all source-to-destination transfers reconcile

title: Cash vs tournament stats
acceptance: Cash $/bb/100/hours and tournament ROI/ITM/finish/fees separate, filterable, no mixed-stakes false displays

title: Confidence communication
acceptance: Small sample or high variance never implies statistically proven positive live win rate

title: Synthetic all-in adjusted EV
acceptance: Until rigorously implemented, display unavailable; if implemented, distinct from decision EV and actual realized net

title: Private server/game boundary
acceptance: Client/bot only receives permitted state; if local-only, disclose local deck inspectability

title: Data export/migrations
acceptance: Versioned import validation, sanitization, partial corrupted payload recovery, unchanged historical stats

title: Opponent model revisions
acceptance: Old session labeled with exact frozen bot/rules versions; no silent re-scoring under new versions

title: Cross-mode bankroll ledger
acceptance: Tournament buy-ins/fees/re-entries/bounties/payouts and cash top-ups are distinct balanced events

title: User data minimization
acceptance: Explicit opt-in for diagnostic histories/telemetry; export/delete; no user private cards publicly logged

title: Raise-to percentage pot: pot $60 before wager, A bets $30, B wants 50%, 100%, 150% pot raise
acceptance: UI shows the documented pot-after-call basis, exact raise-to street total, minimum/maximum legal raise-to; engine accepts those amounts and rejects wrong conversions. Include existing street commitments.

title: Invalid size, stale bet prompt, chip granularity, short-stack jam, mixed $1/$3
acceptance: Bet slider and numeric entry agree; disabled controls if no legal raise; no float drift, duplicate click, or impossible raise allowed.

title: Three simultaneous all-ins and folded dead money, with top-up and cash-out after hand
acceptance: Independent ledger oracle proves wallet+uncommitted stacks+pot commitments+house allocation conserved by source/sink at every event.

title: No rake / %-rake capped / 2-player vs 5-player cap, no flop/no drop; rake before odd-chip splits
acceptance: Source-versioned rake profile produces expected exact integer drop, respects rules and no double rake; unsupported variants disabled.

title: External wallet edit + new session + mixed stakes + a resumed game
acceptance: No historical profit/bb/100 is fabricated or mutated by wallet changes; session assets reconcile; epochs and reason codes visible.

title: Earlier bettor faces two separate short all-in raises whose cumulative increase is enough to reopen
acceptance: Reopening is actor-specific and matches selected verified rule; minimum next full raise remains correct.

title: Earlier bettor faces short all-ins whose cumulative increase is insufficient
acceptance: Earlier bettor may not re-raise; unacted player may still have permitted raise; hand remains finishable.

title: Optional time-seat collection or fee vs per-pot rake across one hour of virtual live time
acceptance: Fee is charged on documented schedule, never on each hand as an accidental hybrid; off by default unless rule sourced; wallet/pots reconcile.

title: Correct published online rake profile (versioned) with changing number of dealt-in players
acceptance: Cap is selected using applicable occupancy as specified, not a static table maximum or Hero count; historic rake profile remains attached to hand.

title: 300 simulated hands/hour played in fast mode, $1/$2, 30-hand/h assumption
acceptance: Display **actual fast-session elapsed time** and separate **10 live-equivalent hours**; no claim that player actually earned the modelled live hourly rate.

title: 100 hands each at $1/$2 and $5/$10 with changes in table stack and external wallet
acceptance: Report stakes-filtered results; optional normalized mixed BB result built from correct per-hand BB and denominator; no hidden averaging of $ wins.

title: Multiway pre-river lock with 2 side pots, one ineligible folded player, all-in equity display
acceptance: All-in adjusted stat is N/A until separately verified; if enabled, side pots and eligible cards reconciled. No spurious decision EV or perfect-info recommendation.

title: All-in on flop, tournament exposure; cash muck policy different
acceptance: Proper burn/turn/river, eligibility, reveal permissions and return of uncalled excess; viewer never sees unexposed folded hands.

title: Fixed-deck lab fixture vs true RNG session vs replay import
acceptance: Lab hands excluded from ordinary win-rate and bankroll performance; each hand has immutable mode/source/ruleset tag; normal gameplay never forces an educational outcome.

title: Toggle run-it-twice and bomb pots before implementation
acceptance: Controls remain disabled with explicit unsupported explanation; no accidental half-enabled alternative pot/deck mechanics.

title: At least eight core profiles on same 2–10-seat settings
acceptance: Meaningful directional contrasts at sufficiently sampled comparable opportunities; no labels with identical conditional policies without warning.

title: Two distinct bots of the same archetype over repeated sessions
acceptance: Stable within-player tendencies but genuine reproducible between-player heterogeneity, without switching labels mid-hand.

title: Human-action records, if licensed, split by player/session/venue/time
acceptance: No player or future-session leakage between training and holdout; complete data provenance, strata and censorship recorded; otherwise `NOT_AVAILABLE`.

title: Human holdout bot action log-loss vs simpler baseline in covered state strata
acceptance: Proper scoring improvement or honest failure reported with confidence and small-N diagnostics; no claim from synthetic-only evaluation.

title: Human vs bot anonymized full-hand decisions, matched stake/seat/stack/rake
acceptance: Blinded comparative review and state coverage recorded; differences and failure modes shown; no single unsupported Turing-test certification.

title: Rare river overbet and board-type groups with 0–10 human samples
acceptance: No numerical high-confidence 'realism' judgment; fallback prior and effective sample size displayed.

title: Bot faces equivalent public state, same own cards, same bot seed, swapped Hero secret holdings
acceptance: Exact same sampled action or probability distribution; cannot inspect Hero hidden cards.

title: Matched preflop→flop→turn→river line, including bluff and thin value
acceptance: Conditional joint-line likelihoods, correlations and deviations from reference/model reported, not just VPIP and c-bet marginals.

title: Gutshot vs double-gutshot, two-tone board, 50% and 150% pot, shallow/deep, action behind
acceptance: Coherent conditional price response; any hard cap must be explicitly lab-only and not leak into human-validated presets.

title: Bot-vs-bot six- and nine-handed ecology with churn, rebuy and mismatched stack depths
acceptance: Humanly recognizable pot composition, raise size mix, multiway fraction and no frozen table/stack dynamics; assumptions documented.

title: Unknown opponent receives concealed stable archetype; export/debug/profile editing during active hand
acceptance: User-facing payload, notes, statistics, tooltips and exports do not reveal identity or hole cards prior to allowed release; private policy remains stable.

title: Published poker performance research loaded as prospective source
acceptance: The system must reject it as an action-frequency calibration dataset absent eligible action-level records, provenance, stratification and license.

title: Strong profile vs frozen adversarial anti-strategies, matched seats and cards where possible
acceptance: Show results and uncertainty across always-minbet, exploit oversized call, value-only river, overbluff, nits and random; never call 'GTO' from wins alone.

title: Time-to-act cues with no-tell and noisy-tell policy, blinded opponent
acceptance: Hidden hand strength not perfectly inferred from cue; disabling tells does not change policy weights, cards or outcomes.

title: Session/table-clustered outcome data and policy version changes
acceptance: Uncertainty estimates use clustered units where applicable; results segregated by version/population and do not treat correlated hands as independent validation.

title: Preset/mode display with varying evidence: designer / synthetic / human-fitted / holdout
acceptance: Provenance shown accurately per archetype, node and stakes; tests alone cannot silently elevate confidence to human validated.

title: Mobile 10-max table facing a raise, with keyboard/touch amount entry
acceptance: Every action accessible; minimum, to-call, total raise-to and amount remaining visible; no overlapped/hidden seat control.

title: New Site creation with old Poker MaxEV project present
acceptance: New project/site identity proven and old project unchanged; signed-off deploy SHA and actual browser smoke recorded.

title: Deployment/rollback after changes in bankroll schema
acceptance: Previous working release can be restored with preserved valid user histories and no duplicated money or orphaned event.

title: 36-player three/four-table tournament with one Hero table slowed 10×
acceptance: Background tables only advance via completed legal hands on documented virtual event clock, not arbitrary timer eliminations or CPU speed.

title: MTT bubble with two simultaneous all-in hands on different tables
acceptance: Synchronization/hand-for-hand settles correct tied elimination order and avoids wrong first in-money assignment.

title: Freezeout/re-entry/guarantee overlay with fees
acceptance: Entrant fees, net contributions, actual funded guarantees, liabilities and prize payouts reconcile without money appearing from nowhere.

title: PKO with multiway side pot, shared knockout winner(s), bounty split and payout retry
acceptance: Each stake and bounty award tied to single eligible elimination and payable once; economy conserved under chosen documented ruleset.

title: Equal hand/stacks in cash and on STT payout bubble
acceptance: Difference, if any, attributable to explicit ICM-aware or tournament heuristic state; numerical ICM only if required full-field input and validated calculation exists.

title: Multiway ICM prize equity test with a known external reference and payout structure
acceptance: Payout model checked to reference at documented precision or disabled/estimated; no use of an unexplained global 'bubble multiplier'.

title: Browser suspended through multiple blind-level boundaries
acceptance: Resume policy preserved; no duplicate scheduled raises, random level jumps or clock running while intentionally paused.

title: Offline interruption during showdown/payout/MTT seating transaction
acceptance: Atomic replay/rollback restores exact legal next state, same stacks and prizes, only one payout/seat assignment.

title: Acceptance-tracker release report
acceptance: Every test status has evidence and build, `NOT_EXECUTED`/`NOT_AVAILABLE`/`BLOCKED` recorded honestly; gates check critical applicable tests rather than test count alone.

title: Resume on bot's turn with previously queued delayed decision
acceptance: Old command rejected by turn nonce; one legal bot action applied once; game never deadlocks or double acts.

title: Full session flow, fast replay, favorites and note taking at 2/6/10 players
acceptance: No compulsory training modal; hand replay and notes respect private-card disclosure; uninterrupted play, touch/keyboard support, bounded storage, no performance regression.

title: Validate production deck unique 52-card Fisher–Yates and unbiased integer selection
acceptance: Code review confirms CSPRNG and rejection sampling; generated statistical diagnostics report N/seeds and no exposed deterministic production override

title: Separate deck and bot RNG streams
acceptance: With identical deck test stream, changing bot processing delays/action stream does not change which card occupies any deck index; production uses independent sources

title: Non-cheating bot projection and private data
acceptance: Attempt to access Hero cards, unrevealed opponent cards, future board and latent unknown personality from bot projection; denied on every stage including Monte Carlo inputs

title: Unknown versus Random identity lifecycle
acceptance: Unknown maintains latent stable profile across hands and reloading without revealing it; Random samples a profile at seat assignment; public statistics only show observations

title: Multiway unequal stacks and layered side-pot distribution
acceptance: Independent oracle computes eligible pots for at least 3 different all-in levels; no winner gets a pot ineligible by commitment; chip conservation including rake

title: Uncalled excess return ordering
acceptance: Excess wager is returned before rake/pot allocation; returned amount receives no rake; replay same settlement never duplicates transfer

title: Odd-chip rule with tied hands and 3-way sidepots
acceptance: Every divisible pot separately splits with the applicable odd-chip award rule and invariant; tournament TDA fixture awards next-left-of-button odd chip

title: Raise-to pot-fraction with prior street contributions
acceptance: For facing bet and previous street commitments, 50/100/150/200% pot controls compute legal total street commitment and display added chips; independently verified fixtures

title: Short all-ins cumulative reopening
acceptance: TDA 2026 v1.1 example plus separately specified cash profile: actor-specific reopen correctly handles multiple short all-ins and full increments

title: Live straddle and blind obligation
acceptance: UTG and button/Mississippi straddle only when ruleset enables; posts proper live/dead amount, tracks option, opening minraise, and preflop order

title: Tournament dead-button and heads-up transition
acceptance: Apply 2026 TDA dead-button rules through eliminated/empty seats and transition heads-up without duplicate/missed BB; reference fixtures

title: Sit-out and missed blind distinctions
acceptance: Cash sit-out follows selected wait/post/missed-blind policy; tournament absent player is dealt out but blinded/anted where rules apply; turn/hand counters accurate

title: Big-blind ante short stack
acceptance: BBA posting priority, insufficient stack and multiway pots follow selected 2026 TDA profile; starting stacks and post-ante elimination order verified

title: Rake cap depends on number dealt in
acceptance: Against declared PokerStars 2026 source fixture, 2, 3–4, and 5+ dealt-in caps and no-flop-no-drop and rounding match source; other venue presets never mislabeled

title: Cash wallet and table ledger transfers
acceptance: Buy-in/top-up/cash-out are internal transfers; manual wallet edit is external; per-hand net unaffected by those events; zero negative or phantom balances

title: Invisible-card counterfactual invariance
acceptance: Holding bot observation and independent bot random stream constant, altering only unseen Hero cards or undealt deck cannot alter legal action distribution/sample

title: Calibration labels preserve human evidence status
acceptance: Synthetic samples can only earn synthetic matched status; empirical label rejected unless consent/licensing, population match, independent holdout and metrics recorded

title: Bot response versus table composition and Hero strategy
acceptance: Same profile plays across three table mixes and two Hero policies; results report node-conditioned deltas and fails if hard-coded VPIP quota destroys rational conditional behavior

title: Multi-street sequence and sizing consistency
acceptance: Compare flop→turn→river action transition probabilities and bet-size distributions by board, position and role on held-out data, or explicitly report no human benchmark

title: Observed card censoring and data provenance
acceptance: Imported observations mark folded/mucked cards unknown and must not infer exact combo or classify player with future cards; consent/license lineage and context recorded

title: Node-opportunity denominators
acceptance: VPIP/PFR/3bet/raise/check-raise/fold-to-Cbet reported using eligible opportunities with demonstrable test histories; minimum N and CI or “insufficient sample”

title: True hand-for-hand across multiple tables
acceptance: All tables complete exactly one hand then wait; multiple eliminations share synchronized round and event-specific tie-break; no extra background hands

title: Tournament event time versus user latency
acceptance: Same strategy/seeds with different browser rendering, tab suspension or user thought time preserves configured event-clock outcomes per pause policy

title: Tournament accounting identities
acceptance: Starting chips + chips from authorized additional entries/rebuys = live + committed chips; fees, guarantee subsidies, payouts and bounty monetary pools separately reconcile

title: KO/PKO split pot and multiple victims
acceptance: Side-pot eligibility determines who earns each knockout; split knockouts and progressive bounty carryover/paid cash reconcile to payout specification

title: bb/100 mixed blind levels, refunds and no double rake
acceptance: Each dealt hand yields net in own BB, count correct, rake applied once, skip demo/lab; mixed stake views disclose mixing and use independent dollar profit

title: Tournament ROI and blind-normalized chips separated
acceptance: Payout minus total entry/reentry/fee costs computes ROI correctly; tournament chipEV cannot be equated with prize $EV or cash-game bb/100

title: All-in adjusted display is not decision EV
acceptance: All-in-adjusted only on separately validated eligible locked pots with known cards; unsupported displays N/A; no solver/true-EV badge without reference

title: Playability of initial vertical slice and game speed
acceptance: User completes 100 continuous hands 2–10 seats with zero invalid state; quick/normal/live-like time modes vary animation only, never dealt cards or rules

title: Snapshot recovery and idempotent settlement
acceptance: Crash/refresh precisely after bot command, street close, unmatched-return and payout; resulting single valid state equals uninterrupted oracle, no double payout

title: Replay and safe history import
acceptance: Export/import versioned hand with state hashes; redacted user export excludes future deck/unknown latent profile; malformed source fails safely without changing history

title: Draw-price profile editor actually affects behavior
acceptance: Controlled gutshot/OESD/flush/combo draws on each street facing 25–200% pot: configurable response curve shifts relevant action frequencies without overriding legality

title: Bot archetypes actually differ
acceptance: Eight initial profiles pass predeclared pairwise conditional-action/sizing diversity metrics in multiple strata; avoid granting any human-like certificate absent human comparison

title: Opponent adaptive memory stays realistic
acceptance: Repeated Hero aggression affects bounded belief updates using only public actions and disclosed cards, with priors/forgetting; impossible immediate perfect read is rejected

title: Mobile and 10-seat UI acceptance
acceptance: On actual 360–430 px mobile view and desktop, action labels, min/max sizing, pot, sidepots and turn readable; confirmation blocks accidental jam/double-submit

title: Platform policy and research compliance
acceptance: Site explicitly states simulator is offline/practice and not real-money or real-time assistance; data ingestion requires right to use; no integration with live poker client

title: Differential 5/7-card hand-ranking oracle
acceptance: Use independent PokerKit (or another separately implemented comparator) to agree on randomized legal hands and targeted wheels, ties, quads, straight flush, board play; record seed/version; comparator disagreement blocks release.

title: Differential hand-state and payout oracle
acceptance: Replay identical legal actions against independent reference engine for matched supported rule settings; compare active actor, wagers, refunds, eligible pots, and final awards; mark unsupported rules explicitly.

title: Suit relabel metamorphic property
acceptance: Permute suit labels consistently across deck and all hands; winner rankings, legal actions and chip outcomes remain identical, ignoring optional suit-display artwork.

title: Integer chip unit round-trip and stake scaling
acceptance: All money uses exact smallest integer units. Convert stakes and all payments to units without floating drift; scaled cash fixtures preserve legal/action ratios and reconciliation.

title: Bet control equivalence including nonzero commitment
acceptance: For each faced bet and pre-existing street commitment, `pot`, `half-pot`, custom percent and numeric raise-to map to legal cumulative street totals; no silent minraise clipping.

title: Dead-button versus forward-moving divergence
acceptance: An elimination fixture produces proper button/blind order under 2026 TDA dead-button and PokerStars forward-moving selectable tournament profiles; choices do not silently cross-contaminate.

title: TDA BB-ante finishing-order calculation
acceptance: Two players bust same hand at a BB-ante table and begin with different relevant stack-after-ante amounts; finish order/bounty are calculated per configured 2026 TDA Rule 22.

title: All-in card reveal after remaining betting
acceptance: All-in main-pot player with two players still able to bet side pot remains concealed until all betting action concludes, then all required hands are tabled under 2026 TDA Rule 17.

title: Unknown HUD never leaks seed or latent profile
acceptance: Unknown/Random named identities, private parameters, deck remainder and unrevealed hole cards remain absent from hero projection, HUD tooltips and client-facing analytics.

title: Replay honors reveal/muck rules
acceptance: Public replay includes only cards legitimately exposed at showdown; mucked cards hidden in hero view. Developer full-state diagnostics are distinctly gated and marked non-training.

title: Export import redaction and integrity
acceptance: Player export omits future deck, internal bot profile, unrevealed cards and private seeds; imported player data cannot forge ledger wins and must pass schema/hash validation.

title: Two active tabs, one ledger writer
acceptance: Two browser tabs try to issue action concurrently: only one action commits, losing tab reloads authoritative state with explicit conflict notice; never duplicate winnings.

title: Mobile suspend and resume with pending bot move
acceptance: Suspend/kill tab while bot thinking or a settlement pending; on recovery state/action revision and payouts match pre-interruption committed events.

title: Stakes preset provenance shown and persisted
acceptance: Default live $1/$2, $1/$3, $2/$5 and higher or online presets disclose synthetic vs human-calibrated status, rake assumptions, rule version, table mix; changes logged in session stats.

title: Human action benchmark needs held-out scoring
acceptance: Where consented dataset exists, score actions and sizes using opportunity-stratified log-loss and calibration on fully held-out players/sessions/venue; no claim for missing stratum.

title: Human-likeness discrimination baseline
acceptance: Blinded experts distinguish human actions vs matched bots with confidence; compare to human-vs-human variation, naive baseline and finite sample uncertainty; disclose failure/unavailable data.

title: Synthetic skill robustness under matched samples
acceptance: Fixed independent naive, balanced, and exploit agents play matched scenarios with independent seeds; report CI and sensitivity to rake/lineup and fail hard on accidental Hero-favoring bias.

title: Performance and accessible table interaction
acceptance: Measure p50/p95 bot response, render time, memory and action error rates on declared reference devices during repeated 2/6/10-seat play; check keyboard/screen reader/color-independent card labels.

title: Bankroll edit with an open hand
acceptance: Edit virtual wallet during unsettled pot: external change is appended to ledger without modifying table bets or pot, or safely queued until hand ends; entire transaction reversible by new adjustment.

title: Tourney event independent of Hero reading speed
acceptance: Run same scripted hero decisions and field seeds at different real user think times and UI animation speeds; final tournament event results remain identical when event-time configuration is identical.

title: Scope lock for tempting competitor features
acceptance: First release remains NLHE cash plus staged tournament; extra games, RTA, peer multiplayer, run-it-twice, chat, dealer-error floor rulings marked optional and cannot block first vertical slice.

title: Executable evidence pipeline and specification precedence
acceptance: Every required critical test has runnable command/fixture plus build+seed+evidence; CI blocks errors; canonical V5 document is authority; V4 archive cannot override it.

title: R1 launch independent from tournaments
acceptance: CI and release criteria permit publishing R1 with every T1/T2/T3 still NOT_EXECUTED, provided every R1 critical cash gate passes. R1 is playable 2–10 seats and not scaffold-only.

title: V5 fixture FIX06 becomes independently executable
acceptance: Construct concrete seat/button/bust before/after state, independently approve TDA dead and PokerStars moving-button expected positions and action order, then run under both profiles; old placeholder cannot PASS.

title: Host Setup known bot but Live Table hides type
acceptance: Configure visible host labeled nit or station; enter Live Table before a hand; no seat label/tooltips/state leak reveals type, exact traits or policy while actions and bankroll remain unchanged.

title: Changing view never changes game or bot policy
acceptance: On same frozen seeded state, switch Host/Live/Study views and confirm identical hand state/revisions, legal actions, bot distributions and settled result.

title: RNG fails closed when secure entropy absent
acceptance: Mock browser crypto secure random unavailable; normal mode refuses to deal and displays actionable error; no Math.random silent fallback. Lab deterministic RNG remains isolated.

title: Private production hand snapshot supports exact recovery
acceptance: Start genuine CSPRNG hand, suspend after preflop and after bot action, reload from private snapshot/events; resume exactly same remaining cards, stacks, bot policy version with no double charge.

title: Player export cannot reveal hidden unknown information
acceptance: Export midhand and after hand with mucked cards; JSON cannot contain unrevealed villain cards, future deck, private seed, bot latent vector or diagnostics. Import public export cannot forge unpaid/duplicated outcomes.

title: Opponent editor independent conditional effect
acceptance: Matched 100k or enough observable opportunities for 25–300% draw call surfaces: modify OESD turn curve only, and show directional frequency effect on targeted cases without unmotivated global VPIP drift or illegal sizes. Report uncertainty.

title: Individual bot memory cannot cross-infer private hands
acceptance: Two villains share a Hero opponent but not private cards; perturb one villain private cards/unknown folded information and validate second villain policy observation and beliefs unchanged.

title: High-volume unfamiliar lineup transfer audit
acceptance: Freeze model cards, run Hero benchmark agents on several heldout table compositions/rake/stack-depths including intentionally counterexploiting bot behavior; report per-lineup sample N, CI and vulnerabilities. No live profit claim.

title: Wallet external edits and mixed-stakes bb/100 period
acceptance: Play cash $1/$2 then $2/$5, edit wallet, rebuy and cash out; verify net profit excludes external edit, per-stake stats computed correctly, mixed metric clearly labeled and old history unchanged.

title: Large bet mobile preview and double input
acceptance: On 360px view facing a 3bet with previous street contribution: pot slider, raise-to dollar amount, additional amount, and exact min/max are legible; rapid double tap only one action is committed.

title: R1 statistical honesty actual vs hypothetical pace
acceptance: Complete exactly N hands with fast and live-like animation controls: observed bb/100 independent of animation speed; app-clock $/hr changes with actual duration; hypothetical live-paced estimate is visibly assumption driven.

title: R1 human behavior label evidence tier
acceptance: For every initial persona card status reads DESIGNED/SYNTHETIC_MATCHED (unless external legal data exists); cannot show human-data fitted, calibrated live room or solver-certified without links and heldout evidence.

title: Post-release feature flag stays disabled
acceptance: Before R1 verify run-it-twice/bomb pots/extra games not accessible via UI, URL or local flags without new compatible authority and tests; backlog IDs preserved.

title: Tournament event admission and prize accounting
acceptance: At R2 stage, verified STT ticket splits entry/fee and prize; completing event leaves no unpaid liability or phantom cash pot; replay same seed yields same payout and placement.

title: MTT whole-field replay vs hero wall-clock
acceptance: At R3 stage, run complete real 18/45/90-player fields with identical field seeds but different Hero think times; elimination and payout agree given same scripted Hero actions and event-time policy.

title: Tournament field variant isolation
acceptance: STT and MTT never apply cash rake or cash wallet stack resets to tournament pot; cash game can be played before and after tournament without altered cash session history.

title: Feature register integrity and priority
acceptance: Every deferred item has a stable FUT ID, status, dependency and testable behavior; release build turns cannot silently upgrade into R1 without explicit scope decision and new tests.

title: Source and build provenance pinned for actual QA
acceptance: Every passing critical test records commit/build, engine+policy+room versions, test input/seed when applicable, actual expected/observed, runtime environment and artifact path; missing evidence blocks release.

title: Bot decision idempotence under UI rerender
acceptance: Freeze legal observation+decisionId; rerender 100 times, pause/resume then retry bot callback; one action+size draw and exactly one reducer event; no extra RNG/ledger change.

title: Late asynchronous bot worker response
acceptance: Start hand A decision, change hand/session/revision via valid action; deliver A result after B starts; reject stale response, no cash/pot/policy change.

title: Crash between bot policy sample and reducer commit
acceptance: Persist pending sealed action, simulate crash before/after dispatch; resume exactly one legal outcome with unchanged deck and wallet total.

title: Allowed opponent-memory event taxonomy
acceptance: After folded private hand and all-in showdown, assert bots record only public legal actions/revealed hole cards, not mucked/future deck or other bot private vectors.

title: Sparse conditional data cannot pass calibration
acceptance: Provide N<10 legitimate gutshot-vs-200%-pot opportunities; outcome explicitly INSUFFICIENT_DATA with denominator and uncertainty; not 0% or human calibrated.

title: Rule-profile freeze across in-progress hand
acceptance: Change rake/blinds/straddle/denomination with active action; settled hand uses original version, next hand new version, ledger/hand replay consistent.

title: Cash interface bet sizing comprehension
acceptance: Three new test users on specified mobile/desktop view must locate minraise, raise-to total and call/additional amount, play 25 hands; record each actual misclick and observed ambiguity. No fictional completion.

title: Browser storage quota failure recovery
acceptance: Force private snapshot save failure and cross-tab stale ownership; visible error, controlled pause/export, no reset or duplicated settled event on reload.

title: Tournament level snapshot with H4H boundary
acceptance: Advance event timer during active H4H hand, freeze level at hand start for all tables, apply next level to following hands per chosen profile; no partial event payout.

title: MTT background scheduler load and cancel
acceptance: On specified phone/desktop seed 18/45/90-player fields, cancel/restart worker during active hand; no phantom elimination, chip creation, stale payouts, report UI latency and resources.
